title: The inset echo, then the question

aliases.name: T40 Inset echo: a historical twin dropped into the plot's room

members.role: the host lands BUILT: today's series, the era the argument is about, read before it makes room
on the general claim the host parks left by one affine transform (0.50, the hand-off form): the right column is freed, the host never covered
twin 1 on its era's word: a chart card drawn for its size (T10c) from the twin's OWN sourced series, titled with its era, on its own axis
ONE slot in the freed column (hand-off, the default): at 0.45 of the stage the card keeps its source; BOOM's stack (0.35 twins) drops it - R26-413
each twin is thrown in on its word (paper mass) - a named thing arrives (E99 s71)
twin 2 on its era's word takes twin 1's slot (the hand-off, s80); twin 1 leaves as it lands, inside E25's 10 s (M12)
the twins leave and the host UN-PARKS (scale 1.0) on the sentence that returns to today
~2.5 s after the restore a '?' lands beside the plot by the right axis, past today's tip and clear of its end tag, and holds (BOOM 08:52.5)

does: The host parks to free a column, the historical twins land beside it on their eras' words - each its own sourced series on its own axis - then leave as the host restores, and a '?' lands beside the plot.

use_when.act: COMPARES / TURNS - today's shape set beside past episodes of the same shape, then left open (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN T40 C16, R36)
use_when.shape: a series whose last datum is today, plus one or two past episodes each with a committed sourced series of its own (series x2: then / now)
use_when.use: the shape rhymes, and the rhyme is the argument; the rhyme is shown, then the open question ('Railways ... then crashed. In two thousand ... then the tower came down. AI spending just crossed eight.')
use_when.dont: over drawn ink (E63) - the twin stands BESIDE the parked plot, never in it; without the twin's own source; a twin on the host's axis - an unrelated measure keeps its own scale, the SAME measure shares the host's domain (E79); the '?' standing in for a claim we could make
